mapper.select: SELECT EMP_NO FROM ( SELECT EMP_NO FROM EMPLOYEE WHERE REGEXP_LIKE(SUBSTR(EMP_NO, 2), '^[0-9]+$') ORDER BY TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(EMP_NO, 2)) DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1
SELECT EMP_ID AS empId, EMP_NO AS empNo, EMP_NAME AS empName, EMP_DEPT AS empDept, EMP_POSITION AS empPosition, EMAIL AS email, TEL AS tel FROM EMPLOYEE ORDER BY EMP_NAME ASC
SELECT EMP_ID AS empId, EMP_NO AS empNo, EMP_NAME AS empName, EMP_DEPT AS empDept, EMP_POSITION AS empPosition, EMAIL AS email, TEL AS tel, HP AS hp FROM EMPLOYEE WHERE EMP_ID = #{empId}
mapper.update:
UPDATE EMPLOYEE
EMP_NAME = #{empName},
EMP_DEPT = #{empDept},
EMP_POSITION = #{empPosition},
EMAIL = #{email},
TEL = #{tel},
HP = #{hp},
EMP_PW = #{empPw},
ADMIN_CODE = #{adminCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR},
EMP_STATUS = #{empStatus, jdbcType=NUMERIC},
WHERE EMP_ID = #{empId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO EMPLOYEE ( EMP_NO, EMP_NAME, EMP_USER_ID, EMP_PW, EMAIL, HP, EMP_DEPT, EMP_POSITION, TEL, ADMIN_CODE, EMP_STATUS ) VALUES ( #{empNo}, #{empName}, #{empUserId}, #{empPw}, #{email}, #{hp, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{empDept}, #{empPosition}, #{tel, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{adminCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{empStatus, jdbcType=NUMERIC} )
mapper.select: SELECT EMP_NO AS empNo, EMP_ID AS empId FROM EMPLOYEE WHERE EMP_NO = #{empNo}
